limits: One-feature slices may combine correlated features unrealistically
Exact here means the stored binary64 tree partition on one finite axis, not mathematical exact arithmetic or a universal numerical certificate
No causal inference, calibrated predictive interval, plausible-wine guarantee or joint multifeature extremum
Stored models, existing artifacts and historical test metrics remain unchanged

protocol.domains: Feature-wise min/max of fitting rows only
protocol.models: Unchanged selected CART and unchanged 32-member group-bagging ensemble
protocol.precision: Binary64 threshold/routing semantics, no input casting to float32
protocol.rows: First three original test rows, no response-driven row choice
protocol.units: Ordinal wine-quality scores treated as numeric model outputs

sweeps.meaning: Binary64 model-response slice holding all other features fixed. Attainable extrema only on this one-axis domain, not causal effects, plausible-input guarantees, prediction intervals or multifeature robustness.
